summary: MapKit covers embedded map views, annotations and overlays, search, geocoding, directions, Look Around and snapshots. BifrOSt has no map view, tiles, annotations, overlays, directions or snapshots, and no SDK map API. The only overlap is text-to-coordinate place search in the Weather app, which uses Open-Meteo rather than Apple services.

gaps: No map view or map tile rendering in the SDK or renderer, so no app can show a map
No annotations, overlays or selectable map features
No reverse geocoding (coordinate to place or address)
No points-of-interest search, nearby search or search completion beyond city and place text search
No location service API for apps (user location on a map)
No map snapshot or static map image export
No maps URL handling or default navigation app
